claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Vinburnine is a vinca alkaloid-related eburnamine derivative with weak adrenergic/cholinergic antagonism and no meaningful antiproliferative potency at 2.5 uM, so it is expected to be largely inactive rather than cytotoxic.
